title: Audi names Schot interim CEO, puts jailed Stadler on leave
text:
BING NEWS: Audi names Schot interim CEO, puts jailed Stadler on leave BERLIN — German automaker Audi has named sales chief Abraham ‘Bram’ Schot as interim CEO following the arrest of Rupert Stadler as part of a probe into emissions cheating.
